quandoUsar: Full-page login screen that offers passkey first, with email plus a 6-digit code and three single sign-on providers as alternatives.
Prototypes and demos that need a navigable sign-in flow without a backend: every step is simulated with timers.
Products where signing in and creating an account share the same card: the button at the top switches between “Sign in” and “Sign up” modes.
quandoEvitar: Use `sign-in` when a standalone email-and-code card is enough, without the ring background, header, and page footer.
Use `signup-form` when account creation asks for name, password, and a strength meter.
Use `otp-input` when you already have the flow and only need the code field.

teclado.acao: In the email field or any code cell, submits the form for the current step.
On the code step, move focus between the cells (`otp-input` behavior).
In an empty code cell, clears the previous cell and moves focus back to it.
Moves through the controls of the step; blocked buttons use `aria-disabled` and stay focusable.

acessibilidade: Each step change is announced by a visually hidden `role="status"` region with `aria-live="polite"`; the visible status line in the footer is `aria-hidden`.
Focus follows the flow: it goes to the passkey button, to the email field, to the first code cell, and, on completion, to the welcome heading.
The provider group is a named `role="group"`, each button has its own `aria-label`, and the resend button reports in its `aria-label` how many seconds remain.
movimento: Steps rise into place from a slight blur and, when going back, drop in from above; the card height follows the new content with a spring that does not overshoot, only during the switch.

The background rings drift slightly with the mouse, the outer ones more than the inner ones; on passkey two rings pulse out from the fingerprint, the resend countdown rolls digit by digit, and success draws a circle and a checkmark.
With “reduce motion” on, steps only fade, the height changes instantly, the rings stay still, and the passkey pulse is not rendered.
responsivo: Uses the block's own container queries: below 520 px and 400 px of width, the spacing, the title, and the provider buttons shrink.
Fills the container width with a minimum height of 640 px; `fullScreen` switches to `min-height: 100dvh` and removes the border and radius.
desempenho: A `ResizeObserver` measures the card to animate its height, and the resend countdown uses a 1 s timer only on the code step; all timers are cleared on unmount.
notasIA: Nothing is actually authenticated: `startPasskey`, `submitEmail`, `verify`, and `signInWith` use `setTimeout`, and `onSignIn(email, method, mode)` only signals that the simulation finished; replace these functions with the real calls.
Props: `fullScreen` to fill the page, `demoCode` (the accepted code, default `482913`), `demoEmail` (the account returned by passkey and providers), `termsHref`, and `privacyHref`.
Depends on `button`, `input`, and `otp-input`; the “ryan-ui” brand and all texts are hardcoded in English in the file, with no props to translate them.
